name: Pausanias of Orestis
role: Assassin of Philip II of Macedon
contribution: A member of Philip II of Macedon's personal bodyguard.

checks.lead: Pausanias of Orestis (Ancient Greek: Παυσανίας ἐκ τῆς Ὀρεστίδος) was a member of Philip II of Macedon's personal bodyguard (somatophylakes). He assassinated Philip in 336 BC. Pausanias was killed while fleeing the assassination.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
